decisions.reason: The _v19 instruction changes delivered document naming, not the required style coverage or additions within the templates.
Naming all new documents _v19 does not change the completed initial assessment method, coverage, time budget, or required assessment outputs.
The package naming instruction does not alter the required legacy copy-paste behavior, test sources, or unresolved workflow question.
Changing filenames to _v19 does not change the required behavior of manual line breaks after pasted content.
The source only specifies the version suffix for delivered documents and does not change editable-field mechanisms or handling.
The _v19 filename designation does not resolve or modify the requirement for tables and columns to remain within page bounds.
The document naming instruction does not change field-label language, text, placement, coverage, or persistence.
Naming delivered documents _v19 does not modify the required bullet appearance or level-4 variant.
The source does not change Tab-key behavior, list hierarchy, or the unresolved user workflow.
The _v19 filename requirement does not change placeholder-clearing behavior in interactive fields.
The version designation for delivered files does not alter typography, emphasis, font sizes, or caption-text styling.
The source changes document filenames only and does not modify the required template theme colors.
